0.a: Yes. BugPk-Api is a free open-source project — every API is free to call, funded by the author and donations. MIT licensed and self-hostable.

1.q: How do I get a key? Any rate limits?
1.a: Sign up, then create keys under "Key management" in the console. Each account has a default QPS quota; over-limit requests get a 429 and recover automatically.

2.q: Which platforms are supported? What quality?
2.a: Douyin, Bilibili, Kuaishou, WeChat Channels, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, YouTube and 33+ platforms via the aggregate API. Parsing APIs return watermark-free original-quality links by default. Parsing APIs are exclusively for backing up works you created and uploaded yourself; do not use them to obtain other people's content.

3.q: A call failed or the link expired — what now?
3.a: Check your key status and QPS quota first; the platform fails over to backup upstreams automatically. Still stuck? Reach out via QQ 10000000 with the returned trace_id.

4.a: Yes. The project is open source on GitHub (MIT) with one-click deploy scripts and Docker support — see the repository README.

5.a: Your account hit its QPS rate limit. Slow down or request a higher quota in the console; the limit uses a per-second sliding window and recovers shortly.

6.q: Can I download other people's videos with the parsing APIs?
6.a: No. The permitted use of parsing APIs is exclusive: retrieving a backup of your own work that you created and uploaded to a platform when your local copy was lost or deleted. Calling them for other people's content, content you hold no rights in, or content restricted by platform rules is out of scope. See Clause 5 of the Terms of Service.
